deployments_detail.use: C3 AI platform for Advanced Metering Infrastructure operations + enterprise data analytics (4M+ customers), grid resilience

ML predictive analytics for operations: Con Edison uses ML for identifying possible safety conditions, forecasting call-center volumes and optimizing staffing, and understanding impacts of new grid technologies (stated in regulatory rebuttal testimony). [none]
Generative AI pilots: company states it is in the early stages of developing generative-AI pilots (not yet in production; no Agentic AI implemented), per regulatory testimony. [none]

C3 AI AMI Operations: enterprise ML platform monitoring smart-meter and network health across ~5 million meters, using self-tuning ML algorithms and 50 analytics to flag deployment/installation issues and enable predictive maintenance. [C3 AI]
deployments_detail.value: $854 million+ identified annual customer benefit; 2,300+ deployment issues found in 4 months; 5M meters

deployments_detail.use: Conservation Voltage Optimization (CVO): AI application that optimizes voltage across distribution grids to reduce energy needed for adequate service, covering ~3.1 million electric meters. [C3 AI]
deployments_detail.value: Estimated 1.5% energy savings over 20 years with 3% voltage reduction; ~3.1M meters, 5M customers

deployments_detail.use: Grid Modernization application: identifies abnormal neutral-leg voltages, detects outage anomalies, and optimizes/prioritizes work orders based on street status and site access. [C3 AI]
Hot Socket Monitoring solution: detects meter/socket overheating and manages the resolution lifecycle; prototyped in C3 AI Ex Machina then deployed into AMI Operations. [C3 AI]

No-code ML with C3 AI Ex Machina: Con Edison data analysts build predictive models to identify smart meters at risk of overheating, generating near-real-time risk scores to schedule field maintenance and cut reporting timelines. [C3 AI]

AI for underground power-cable fault detection: Con Edison engineer worked with Schneider Electric's AI experts (AI at Scale program) to detect and help prevent faults across NYC's underground cable network. [Schneider Electric]

ROAMS (Ranker for Open-Auto Maintenance Scheduling): ML system that ranks distribution feeders by failure susceptibility; rankings retrained daily and used to guide contingency analysis and winter/spring replacement programs. [Columbia University (CCLS) / Con Edison in-house]

Underground Live End Cap Machine (with ULC Technologies): robotic/automated tool that end-caps and isolates damaged underground cables to improve worker safety, precision, uniformity and speed; in field testing. [ULC Technologies]

Microsoft 365 Copilot: generative-AI assistant licensed as part of Con Edison's Microsoft enterprise agreement (server/database/desktop OS, M365 Copilot, Defender), per IT panel rebuttal testimony. [Microsoft]
AI-based Revenue Protection application: detects energy theft and revenue loss by leveraging meter alarms and related data. [C3 AI]

'Watt' virtual assistant / customer chatbot: handles start/move service, bill payment, payment agreements, outage status, billing preferences and program enrollment 24/7; integrates with Amazon Alexa and Google Home for voice balance inquiries and payments. [none]
deployments_detail.value: "helped thousands of customers" since launch (no exact figure)
